title: Customer Onboarding & Account Setup Walkthrough
description: Step-by-step video guide explaining user registration, profile setup, and two-factor authentication.

segments.title: Welcome & Account Creation Form
segments.summary: Walks through filling out the initial registration form with name, business email, and secure password.
segments.transcript: Hello and welcome. In this video, we will walk you through setting up your account. First, click on the Register button in the top right corner...
possible_questions: How do I create a new account?
Where do I enter my business email to register?

segments.title: Two-Factor Authentication Setup (2FA)
segments.summary: Demonstrates scanning the QR code using Google Authenticator and verifying the 6-digit confirmation code.
segments.transcript: Next, to keep your data secure, we require two-factor authentication. Open your authenticator app on your phone, scan this QR code on the screen...
possible_questions: How do I set up two-factor authentication?
What app should I use to scan the 2FA QR code?

segments.title: Company Profile & Team Invitations
segments.summary: Explains how to add company details, logo, and invite additional team members via email.
segments.transcript: Now that your account is protected, let's configure your workspace profile. Under organization settings, enter your company name and invite your colleagues...
possible_questions: How do I invite my coworkers to the workspace?
Where can I upload my company logo?
